page: UpCloud GPU-20xCPU-256GB-3xL4 is a GPU-accelerated virtual server built on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 CPU architecture. It features 20 shared vCPUs paired with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 12.8 GB of RAM per core. The primary hardware highlight is the inclusion of three NVIDIA L4 GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, providing a combined total of 72 GB of VRAM.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning external storage volumes must be attached for persistent data. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the shared CPU allocation combined with high-density system memory and triple NVIDIA L4 GPUs offers a specialized hardware profile for parallel computing tasks without the premium cost of dedicated CPU cores.

The hardware configuration is designed for workloads requiring substantial graphics processing power and memory capacity. Suitable use cases include machine learning inference, data science jobs, video transcoding, and parallelized analytical processing where GPU acceleration is critical but local high-speed storage is not pre-bundled.
